notes:
### BondoMod v0.1.99

- Fixed corrupted match statistics when using spawned items.
- Improved Item Spawn stability across launches, matches, goals, and menu returns.
- Prevented harmless local connection checks from disconnecting BondoSpawner.
- Item Spawn now leaves the Windows system proxy disabled for better ping and Epic connectivity.
- Discord login now retries temporary connection failures and shows a clear error instead of `fetch failed`.
- Improved recovery for Steam and Epic Games connection failures.

Some bugs may still occur. Please report them immediately so they can be fixed.
